artworks.title: Sun and Rain
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.2 × 8.4 cm (2 7/16 × 3 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a volcanic eruption on the left side, with a settlement and hills in the distance on the horizon. The technique uses fine, linear ink strokes to create texture and movement, particularly in the depiction of the explosion and the smoke. Sun rays on the right side angle downward. The color palette is monochrome, with black ink on a light background, emphasizing the detail and line work.

artworks.title: The Two Crowns
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.3 cm (2 1/2 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with an elevated viewpoint. Near the top, there is a horizon with a distant landscape and a cliff-like structure. In the center, there is a detailed crown with a human face. Below the crown, there is a laurel wreath, scrolls, and a rocky landscape as the background. The color palette is monochromatic with dark ink strokes on light paper.

artworks.title: The Nile Flooding
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6 × 8.5 cm (2 3/8 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a body of water, rolling hills, and structures. The horizon is below the center, marked by the meeting of water and land. There are sail-like shapes in the distance. Fine lines and hatching provide texture and detail. The color scheme is simple, primarily natural and dark ink. A bare tree is on the right, framing the composition. The land beyond the water has gentle slopes, buildings, and vegetation.

artworks.title: Lydia and Her Mother at Tea
artworks.description: Two individuals are seated closely together. The person on the left is partially obscured by a cup while drinking, and they have short hair. The individual on the right is in profile, with identifiable facial features and short, neatly combed hair. Both are wearing dark formal clothing, with a textured background and table setting between them consisting of ornate silverware on a circular tray.

artworks.title: Before the Fireplace (No. 1)
artworks.medium: softground etching and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman depicted in profile, focusing on her upper body as she reclines on an armchair with an elegantly patterned fabric. Her position is relaxed, leaning slightly back with her head supported by her hand. She has delicate facial features, with a serene expression. Her hair is neatly combed and falls on her shoulders. The woman wears a dark garment, possibly a dress, contrasting with the lighter background. The background consists of a textured wall with a prominent mantle above a fireplace.

artworks.title: A Portrait of the Artist's Mother
artworks.medium: softground etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated in a contemplative pose. The individual is facing to the side, with their chin resting on one hand. Their closed eyes and calm expression suggest a moment of thought. The person has short, light-colored hair and wears a dark garment underneath a light-colored shawl. They are holding the edge of the shawl with one hand. In the background, there are two abstract floral or fan-like forms on either side of the person against a plain backdrop. The image is in a monochromatic sepia tone.

artworks.title: A Portrait of the Artist's Mother
artworks.medium: softground etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features an upper three-quarters view of a person sitting in a chair. The person is positioned slightly turned to the side, with their left hand raised to their face, touching their chin. The facial features are subtly outlined, with short and neatly groomed hair. The clothing appears to be a loose, flowing garment draped over their shoulders, with a darker line or pattern near the edge. In the background, there is a faint outline of a vase with flowers or reeds. The overall tone of the artwork is in muted sepia. There are no clear indications of jewelry or objects being held. The background is softly textured.

artworks.title: Interior: On the Sofa
artworks.description: The image shows a seated person from the waist up, turned slightly to their right. The person's head is facing the viewer, with distinct facial features framed by short, tousled hair. They are wearing a dark outfit. The person is on an upholstered item with bold floral or leafy patterns. The background suggests a room with simple furnishings, potentially including a picture or mirror on the wall above the person. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The scene is rendered in a sketch-like style with varying intensities of shading in the background.

artworks.title: Degas
artworks.description: The image is a sketch depicting the right profile of a man's head and shoulders. The man is facing to the right, with his head slightly tilted. He has a long nose, a full beard, medium-length tousled hair, and a garment covering his shoulders. The background is plain with no other details. The sketch is enclosed within a rectangular border and there is a signature or inscription below it.

artworks.title: Renoir Seated
artworks.description: The image depicts a male figure in a three-quarter view, seated in a relaxed position on a chair. His body is angled slightly towards the right with one leg crossed over the other. His left hand supports his head as it rests on his cheek, and his right hand rests on the armrest of the chair. The man has short hair and a full beard. He is wearing a collared jacket and trousers. The background is plain, with a light, textured surface.

artworks.title: Actresses in Their Dressing Rooms
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on wove paper

artworks.title: Un enano (A Dwarf)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from head to knees. The person is seated with their legs crossed and hands resting on their lap. They have strong facial features including a broad forehead, deep-set eyes, a mustache, and a small beard. Their dark hair is styled combed back. The person wears a long, patterned robe with wide sleeves and a decorative collar. They are sitting against a textured background and the image is framed with an inscription relating to the artist Diego Velázquez.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Large Lake at Center
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a body of water, surrounding land, structures, rolling hills, trees, vineyard-like patterns, distant structures, a large tree, buildings, watercraft, and a monochromatic color palette. The style is detailed and delicate, resembling a pen and ink drawing.

artworks.title: James Nares
artworks.medium: graphite, black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a pastel drawing of an older man depicted in a head-and-shoulders view. He is facing slightly to his left with his upper body turned towards the viewer. The man has deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and thin lips. His hair is styled in 18th-century fashion with white, tight curls pulled back with a ribbon. He is wearing a dark coat over a high-collared white shirt and a circular pin on the left side of his coat. The background is plain with light shading around the figure.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: This is an image of a biblical scene. The scene shows a central figure nailed to a cross, with rays of light coming from the clouds above. Below the cross, two figures stand with expressions and postures indicating lamentation or reverence. The background includes rolling hills and rugged terrain. The image is drawn in delicate lines with attention to texture and details in garments and landscape. The composition is balanced with the crucifix on the right and the other figures and landscape filling the rest of the frame.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Castle and Radiating Sun
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with an elevated castle on a hill surrounded by dense trees. Mountain ranges can be seen in the background, with the sun shining from the right side, casting light and shadows across the scene. The illustration uses detailed line work and cross-hatching techniques, creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing contrast and shading. In the foreground, there are small buildings, trees, and a winding path leading towards the castle.

artworks.title: Saints Peter and Paul Seated in a Landscape
artworks.description: The image shows two men seated on a rocky surface. The man on the left holds a book in his left hand and rests his right hand on his lap. He wears a loose-fitting robe and is barefoot. Next to him is an object resembling a large knife. The man on the right points with one hand and holds an open book on his knee. He also wears a robe with billowing sleeves. In the background, a wooded area with a few trees is visible.

artworks.title: The Lamentation
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures in the foreground, with a full display of their bodies. The central figure is a lifeless male, reclining in the arms of individuals surrounding him. His head is cradled by a woman who kneels in front of him. The people around him are positioned in seated or kneeling stances, dressed in draped garments. Their facial features are detailed, conveying a sense of concentration or mourning. The background is a rocky landscape with a large wooden cross, and a cityscape in the distance. Various objects lie on the ground near the group, including a crown of thorns and nails.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene in a pastoral landscape. The image shows a group of figures gathered closely together. Some have wings and are holding a musical scroll. In the center, a robed figure with long hair holds a smaller figure. In the background, a rocky, mountainous landscape appears with a city or village visible under a lightly clouded sky. The linework defines the folds of the garments and the texture of the terrain in detailed and intricate ways.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.description: The image shows a Nativity scene with Mary holding baby Jesus. She is surrounded by three figures, likely the Magi, one kneeling and two standing. Another figure is standing to the side. The background includes an architectural structure with hills in the distance.

artworks.title: Peasant and Egg Woman
artworks.description: The image shows two figures depicted in a detailed etched style. The standing person holds a walking stick. They have curly hair, wear a cap, loose-fitting garment, tunic, leggings, and slip-on shoes. The seated person's face is partially covered by a wimple. They wear a long gown, and their hands appear to hold small round objects. Next to them is a basket filled with similar objects. The background features horizontal lines indicating a wooden or textured wall and a simple area suggesting steps or a platform.

artworks.title: Two Loves
artworks.description: This image shows two winged figures standing near a tree. The figures are positioned around a tree trunk, with one of them holding a seashell. In the background are smaller trees and a building under a clear sky. The drawing uses line work to create texture and depth, especially in the wings and tree bark.

artworks.title: Gardeuse d'oies nue (Nude Goose Girl)
artworks.description: The image displays the back view of a nude individual standing by a riverbank. The person is depicted from the head to the lower legs, standing upright with one arm raised, potentially against a tree or holding onto a draped cloth. The individual's facial features are obscured, and they have short, dark hair. The person is surrounded by trees, foliage, and ducks in the water nearby, contributing to a serene and natural environment. The background consists of more trees and plants, creating a lush outdoor atmosphere.

artworks.title: Wooded Landscape at L'Hermitage, Pontoise (Paysage sous bois, a L'Hermitage, Pontoise)
artworks.medium: aquatint, soft-ground, and drypoint on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image shows a cluster of trees creating a lattice. In the background, there are structures, possibly cottages or farmhouses, and hills in the distance. The brushstrokes are loose and impressionistic, creating a soft, misty quality. The scene is in muted tones of grayscale, with varying shades from dark shadows to light highlights. In the foreground, there is rough-textured ground with foliage and a figure with their back turned. The background merges with the trees.
